evidence: atomic reject supplies 0 and leaves management state unchanged
partial complete supplies 12, resets interval state and stores no residual event
partial residual-active supplies 12 and stores residual 8 as explicit management memory
partial complete and partial residual-active can have identical current water but different future event demand
accepted finalize commits water and management state together
rollback rejects water and management state together
full supply collapses all policies to one completed-event state
allocation shortfall remains diagnostic unless explicitly promoted to residual event state
interpretation: External scarcity cannot be mapped onto a discrete SWAP-like irrigation event by changing only a volume. The coupled contract must also define event-state transition. Water realization and event management state must commit or roll back atomically.
production_boundary: no policy is claimed as current production SWAP behavior under external scarcity
legacy B1.10 captures irrigation continuation, while current FMR physical state does not yet expose F-APP07 continuation state
production selection of atomic/partial-complete/residual-active semantics remains a separate design decision
downstream: DUMMY-15D may now qualify gross source withdrawal, canopy storage, interception evaporation and net soil irrigation as distinct ledger terms.
